description: This file defines the IHdcpProfile interface and related structures for HDCP status and notifications within the WPEFramework's Exchange namespace. It includes method declarations for registering notifications, retrieving HDCP status, and supported HDCP versions.

classes.name: IHdcpProfile
classes.description: Interface for HDCP profile management, including status retrieval and notification registration.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Structure representing the HDCP connection and compliance status, including protocol versions and reason codes.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Interface for HDCP-related event notifications, such as display connection changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for HDCP profile events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetHDCPStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current HDCP status and indicates success.

methods.name: GetSettopHDCPSupport
methods.description: Retrieves supported HDCP version and support status of the set-top box.
